title: ICA Sudan, 2018 - Prevalence of Malnutrition, 2013

resources.description:
This layer contains information about the malnutrition levels - by second-level administrative unit - used for the purposes of the Integrated Context Analysis (ICA) run in Sudan in 2018.
Data source: Simple Spatial Survey Method (S3M), 2013.
The main indicators used for the analysis were the overall prevalences of stunting and wasting, with thresholds consistent with the guidelines suggested by the World Health Organization (WHO).
